ns2:section.sectionText: Fast Reactor Sci & Eng. 3 hr section. Third hour requires extra projects and papers. Will apply towards tech electives for NPRE undergraduates in the Power concentration. Fast reactors have the potential to simultaneously address the nuclear fuel shortage as well as the waste issues. The science and technology of fast reactors in many ways differs from that of currently prevalent thermal reactors. This course will focus on the science, engineering and technology of the various fast reactor designs.
